scope: Independent read-only review of Grok revision002 T8103 UAT scalar codec and software walker, especially nonzero offsets, block refusal and executable format scope. No kernel/GPU readiness clearance.

approved_findings.finding: T8103 numeric profile matches acquired primary bytes: level shifts39/36/25/14, entries2/8/2048/2048, 16K granule, per-root IAS39, PA/OAS40 and64contexts with16-byte TTBR pairs. Descriptor field width48 is not used as physical width.

TTBR ASID63:48 / address47:1 / valid0 and PTE OS55 UXN54 PXN53 PA47:14 nG11 AF10 SH9:8 AP7:6 attr4:2 type1 valid0 match the pinned descriptor classes. Canonical software policy rejects nonzero-invalid descriptors, reserved bits, unaligned addresses and physical bits40..47; it is stricter than blindly masking input.
Page translation adds all low14 VA bits, including nonzero offsets. Both root halves and sign-extended upper-half addresses preserve the same offset; highest legal PA page plus0x3fff remains2^40-1.

Block descriptors may be represented arithmetically, but translate stops immediately with translation=refused, raw_output/span/virtual_offset and NO pa in either outer result or descriptor. This fixes root001 counterexample without pretending the pinned helper implements hardware block translation. Tested level1 and level2 with nonzero offsets.
Only t8103 is executable. G15 and other generation names are rejected; G15 geometry remains explicitly non-executable provenance and its unknown output width is not replaced by48.

checks.independent_method: Loaded only the pure codec with Python -B; constructed raw little-endian descriptor words/tables independently of its encoder. Covered upper/lower roots, maximal L1/L2/L3 indices, sign extension, low offsets1/0xfff/0x1000/0x2345/0x3fff, top physical page, and block low offsets1/0x12345/span-1. Input table bytes unchanged after walks. No m1n1 runtime module imported.

limits: This is scalar encoding and caller-supplied path walking, not a whole physical-page ownership/lifetime or isolation validator.
Logical L1 used-entry slice is64bytes; it does not replace the future properly aligned, retained16K physical table allocation and publication requirements.
No permission enforcement, firmware context handoff, GPU/MMIO access, TLB invalidation, coherency, DMA, IOMapper or native adapter is qualified.
Block refusal is the approved boundary; lack of support in these helper functions is not a claim that hardware cannot implement blocks.
Current private desktop/native input evidence does not provide GPU execution evidence.
